query: UPDATE observations SET title = $3, body = $4, revision = revision + 1, access_level = $5::smallint, producing_ceiling = $6::smallint, watermark_kind = $7, watermark_level = $8::smallint, source_max_level = $9::smallint, carried_level = $10::smallint, updated_at = now(), index_state = 'pending', index_error = NULL, index_attempts = 0, next_index_at = now(), index_lease_until = NULL, index_fence = index_fence + 1 WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 RETURNING revision
